item.title: China to Impose 13% Tax on Condoms, Contraceptives from January 2026
item.description: Ghazali Ibrahim The Chinese government has announced it will begin taxing condoms and other contraceptives starting January 1, 2026, ending a decades-long tax exemption on such products. The new policy will subject these items to the standard 13% value-added tax (VAT) under China’s updated tax code.
